entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: The ten-thousand-year anniversary of the signing of the Guildpact on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Magical contract that kept Ravnica's guilds in balance, broken during the Decamillennial.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: Parun of the Selesnya Conclave and elemental embodiment of Ravnica's power.

entities.name: Chorus of the Conclave
entities.description: Selesnyan dryad-led group performing the convocation.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild led by Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Bayul
entities.description: Non-dryad member of the Chorus who died after passing his gem to Fonn.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Ledev guardian who received Bayul's gem.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: Rising Golgari power who sought Bayul's gem and made the quietmen.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: Guild of which Savra was a power.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Savra's brother who became the new Golgari guildmaster.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Ancient vampire and master of House Dimir, architect of the chaos.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: Secretive guild long thought a myth.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Wojek lawkeeper who arrested Szadek.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Guild whose members were revealed to be Lupul infiltrators.

entities.name: Lupul
entities.description: Shapeshifting infiltrators serving Szadek.

entities.name: Quietmen
entities.description: Necromantically crafted ghost-warriors produced by Savra.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Great City-Tree of the Selesnya.

entities.name: Biracazir
entities.description: Fonn's mortally wounded wolf.

entities.name: Myczil Zunich
entities.description: Fonn's father who died 57 years earlier.

entities.name: Luda
entities.description: Girl whose death sparked the investigation, revealed to be a Lupul.

events.summary: The Selesnyan leaders prepare to perform the convocation to bless Ravnica on the day of the Decamillennial.
events.quote: prepared to perform the convocation, a sacred ritual intended to bless the entire plane

events.summary: Bayul passes his gem to Fonn Zunich before dying.
events.quote: Bayul ultimately passed his gem to his ledev guardian Fonn Zunich before dying

events.summary: Boros Legion members are revealed to be Lupul and attack Fonn and her allies, who narrowly escape.
events.quote: Fonn and her allies narrowly escaped their attack

events.summary: Savra mixes quietmen among the Selesnyans and infects the roots of Vitu-Ghazi.
events.quote: She had mixed her quietmen among the Selesnyans

events.summary: Szadek snaps Savra's neck and kills the dryads of the Chorus linked with her.
events.quote: Savra’s ally turned on her in an instant, snapping her neck

events.summary: Szadek tears open Vitu-Ghazi and feeds on Mat'Selesnya.
Jarad seizes Savra's staff and turns Szadek's Lupul against him.
events.quote: Jarad vod Savo , Savra’s brother, seized Savra’s staff

events.summary: Fonn places Bayul's gem on her dying wolf Biracazir, reviving the Chorus and Mat'Selesnya, whose power destroys the shapeshifters and leaves Szadek a charred husk.
events.quote: she placed it on her mortally wounded wolf , Biracazir .

events.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, which technically breaks the Guildpact.
events.quote: Agrus Kos stepped forward to formally arrest the vampire

events.summary: Aftermath: Jarad becomes Golgari guildmaster, Kos prepares to leave the force, and Luda's body is revealed to be a Lupul.
events.quote: Jarad rising as the new Golgari guildmaster

relations.quote: the ancient vampire and master of House Dimir
